newsitem.title: USA: US spot resids mostly unchanged, Gulf HSFO softer.
newsitem.headline: US spot resids mostly unchanged, Gulf HSFO softer.

text.p: U.S. spot residual fuel oil prices finished Wednesday mostly unchanged, while high-sulphur values in the U.S. Gulf were softer after recent strength on talk of supply tightness.
"Gulf (high-sulphur prices) has been a little overdone," said one physical trader, adding there were HSFO offers coming from Caribbean storage and South American producers.

Barge traffic along the Mississippi River remained tied up amid ongoing efforts to clean up a petro-chemical spill that occurred last week's accident when a vessel carrying the toxic substance was grounded.

In the Gulf, the three percent sulphur grade widened to $14.00-14.50 a barrel from Tuesday's $14.25-14.50. Three percent paper stepped down at $13.75-13.90 from $13.80-14.00 Tuesday. One percent physical was thinly talked at $14.88.
In the New York harbor market, spot fuel fuel prices were mostly steady from yesterday's level on expectation of utility demand to replenish resid inventory after the winter season.
"The (NYH) market will hold for the rest of the month," said the physical trader.
NYH one percent physical widened to $15.75-16.25 a barrel compared with $16.00-25 Tuesday. One percent NYH paper for April fell to $15.35-50 from yesterday's $15.60-80.
NYH HSFO grades were mostly unchanged with 2.2 percent holding at $14.00-25 and heard offered as high as $15.00.
The NYMEX May crude contract settled down 35 cents at $20.64 a bbl after losing nearly $1 the past three sessions.
At the New York City gate, day-ahead natural gas gained on strength in the Gulf Coast prices and forecasts of cooler weather this weekend.
Swing gas deliveries at New York City gate edged up to $2.17-2.22 per million British thermal units (mmBtu) or $13.86 a barrel equivalent from Tuesday's $2.15-2.20 or $13.61 a barrel equivalent.
Natgas at Henry Hub, the NYMEX delivery point, finished flat from yesterday's at $1.84/mmBtu or $11.59/bbl equivalent.
